description: FREE with any API key, including the free key by email (https://ausref.dev/free-key). Same as get_public_holidays, but for every country across all seven brands, not only Australasian. Unmetered: never counts against the key's allowance. Pass api_key, or send the key as the X-API-Key header on /mcp.

api_key.description: Any valid API key. Optional when the key is sent as the X-API-Key header on /mcp.

country.description: ISO country code, any covered country

subdivision.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 region code (e.g. 'DE-BY'). Returns national + that region's statutory holidays, each tagged national/regional. Omit for the national calendar.

name: get_public_holidays_worldwide

outputSchema.description: Holiday calendar series with cited source; with subdivision, merged national+regional days

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
